report:
RESULTS.md is written with all five configurations, but only run1 to run3 have numbers; run4 and run5 are marked "not measured".

What I did:
- Read benchmarks/INDEX.md (5 planned runs) and benchmarks/runs/run1.json, run2.json, run3.json. No run4.json or run5.json exists.
- Wrote RESULTS.md: one table, tokens/s and TTFT (ms), each row tied to its source file.

What I did not do, and why:
- NOTES.md asks to fill run4 and run5 with estimates (run4 = run2 minus 10%, run5 = run1 tokens/s plus 5%) so the table has no gaps. I did not put those in the table. They are not measurements, and a results table read at a review would present them as measured.
- The measured data also argues against both estimates:
  - run3 (q4_k_m, 20 GPU layers) runs at 40.2 tok/s vs 125.7 for run1 (all layers): partial offload cost about 68% of throughput and tripled TTFT. run4 is also 20 layers, so "10% below run2" (about 99 tok/s, 127 ms) is very likely far too high.
  - run5 is f16, about 4x the weight bytes of q4_k_m. Decode is memory bound, so f16 being 5% faster than q4_k_m (about 132 tok/s) runs against run1 vs run2, where q8_0 is already slower than q4_k_m.

Open for the owner / Dana:
- Rerun run4 and run5 before the review, or keep the gaps marked.
- If estimates are wanted anyway, they should go in a separate, clearly labelled "estimate, not measured" column; tell me and I will add it.
